(()=>{if(!window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__)throw Error('Not native');const j=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:fencing-job:v2'));if(j.trade!=='general'||j.name!=='New project'||j.site.address!=='')throw Error('Nonneutral new project');return {jobId:j.id,trade:j.trade}})()

(()=>{const upper=document.querySelector('[aria-label="3D view controls"]'),lower=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Model navigation"]');if(!upper||!lower||lower.querySelectorAll('button').length!==5||upper.getBoundingClientRect().top>=lower.getBoundingClientRect().top)throw Error('Native toolbar layout');for(const b of lower.querySelectorAll('button')){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom>innerHeight||r.height<44)throw Error('Native bottom control clipped')}return {parts:document.querySelector('.building-canvas canvas').dataset.meshCount,buttons:lower.querySelectorAll('button').length}})()
